# Announcement Bar

`promotional/announcement-bar` &middot; section-level &middot; category: promotional

## Purpose

A thin band at the very top of the email with one line of news and an optional link.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `link` | link |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Light text on the primary color.
- **accent**: White text on the accent color. Sets `background: @colors.accent`, `textColor: @colors.white`, `linkColor: @colors.white`.
- **light**: Text on the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`, `textColor: @colors.text`, `linkColor: @colors.link`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `textColor` | text | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `linkColor` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Solid band with centered text, honored. | Fine. | Light variant swaps with the surface. Colored bars keep their colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('promotional/announcement-bar', {
  "text": "Free shipping on orders over $75.",
  "link": {
    "label": "Shop now",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/all"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "promotional/announcement-bar",
  "data": {
    "text": "Free shipping on orders over $75.",
    "link": {
      "label": "Shop now",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/all"
    }
  }
}
```
